ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Deportment is regulated bodily bearing in walking, standing, sitting, and lying down, and more broadly the visible conduct expected of a monastic.
EvidenceBody: Chan records neither erase the rule nor reduce it to etiquette: they cite formal bearing, ask where it is displayed, and test whether conduct and understanding agree.
